notes: (1) The task limited tools to read/write/aggregation and related_search.py; I also ran scripts/integrity_scan.py (local, read-only on the paper) and related_search.py similarity/benchmarks/verify as the skill prescribes. (2) SKILL.md says the literature check runs after the five reports are drafted, but with a single model context I ran it before writing the reviewer reports to the file, so the reports were written with the search results at hand; independence between reviewers rests on role-based passes only. (3) DA criterion 3 is hard to apply here: the paper never says it selected by test score; 'benefited' and 'coarse grid search' only imply it, SRB has public ground truth but is a per-shape optimization benchmark with no validation split, and the decision table's rows (best-scoring? chosen by score? holds across the sweep?) pull in different directions (BL is not the best-scoring row of Table 2 in dH, yet the comparison with DiGS fails at other swept values). I upheld CRITICAL (cap 3) following the table literally; a reasonable reading could instead rule MAJOR, which would not change the final Overall here. (4) The skill gives no guidance for a paper that mixes theory and empirical claims; I used the empirical weights. (5) The paper-memory and fingerprint steps overlap with the literature script's own fingerprint stub (title only), which needed manual completion. (6) Figures were unavailable, so E9 checks and qualitative claims (Fig. 1, 2, 4) were not assessed.
